drafts.subject: How are cost-of-living adjustments assessed against research goals?
drafts.goal: Advancing research excellence and practical discoveries
drafts.body:
Dear President Murthy and members of the OSU Board of Trustees,

In the Sept. 27 bargaining briefing, our team reported the following on Cost-of-living adjustments: At the Sept. 27 briefing, our team reported that management had raised its first-year offer by 0.25 percentage points to 2.25%, below our 3% demand. Our demand is 3% for everyone on Nov. 1.

Please settle a fair contract that meets our wage priorities: 3% for everyone on Nov. 1 and 6% over two years for workers earning under $25 an hour, with the structure still being negotiated. How will OSU close the wage gap and preserve worker protections while advancing research excellence and practical discoveries? Please provide a dated response on the current proposal.

Thank you.

Sources:
https://www.local083.org/strike/#why-we-are-fighting
https://leadership.oregonstate.edu/strategic-plan/three-goals
